# nxos_ipv4 (Data Source)

This data source can read the IPv4 configuration on NX-OS devices, including per-VRF static routes with next hops and interface addresses.

### API Documentation

- [ipv4Entity](https://pubhub.devnetcloud.com/media/dme-docs-10-6-3/docs/Layer%203/ipv4:Entity/)
- [ipv4Inst](https://pubhub.devnetcloud.com/media/dme-docs-10-6-3/docs/Layer%203/ipv4:Inst/)
- [ipv4IPLoadSharing](https://pubhub.devnetcloud.com/media/dme-docs-10-6-3/docs/Layer%203/ipv4:IPLoadSharing/)
- [ipv4Dom](https://pubhub.devnetcloud.com/media/dme-docs-10-6-3/docs/Layer%203/ipv4:Dom/)
- [ipv4Route](https://pubhub.devnetcloud.com/media/dme-docs-10-6-3/docs/Layer%203/ipv4:Route/)
- [ipv4Nexthop](https://pubhub.devnetcloud.com/media/dme-docs-10-6-3/docs/Layer%203/ipv4:Nexthop/)
- [ipv4RtStaticBfd](https://pubhub.devnetcloud.com/media/dme-docs-10-6-3/docs/Layer%203/ipv4:RtStaticBfd/)
- [ipv4If](https://pubhub.devnetcloud.com/media/dme-docs-10-6-3/docs/Layer%203/ipv4:If/)
- [ipv4Addr](https://pubhub.devnetcloud.com/media/dme-docs-10-6-3/docs/Layer%203/ipv4:Addr/)

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "nxos_ipv4" "example" {
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `device` (String) A device name from the provider configuration.

### Read-Only

- `access_list_match_local` (String) Access-List Match Local.
- `admin_state` (String) The administrative state of the object or policy.
- `control` (String) The control state.
- `hardware_ecmp_hash_offset_concatenation` (String) hardware Ecmp HashOffset Concatenation.
- `hardware_ecmp_hash_offset_value` (Number) hardware Ecmp HashOffset Value.
- `hardware_ecmp_hash_polynomial` (String) hardware Ecmp Hash-Polynomial.
- `id` (String) The distinguished name of the object.
- `instance_admin_state` (String) The administrative state of the object or policy.
- `load_sharing_concatenation` (String) Concatenation.
- `load_sharing_ecmp` (String) ECMP load sharing.
- `load_sharing_exclude_l3_protocol` (String) Exclude L3 Protocol field from ECMP hashing.
- `load_sharing_gre_outer_hash` (String) GRE Outer Hash.
- `load_sharing_keyshift` (Number) hardware lb-keyshift.
- `load_sharing_mode` (String) Load sharing mode.
- `load_sharing_rotate` (Number) Rotate.
- `load_sharing_second_hierarchy_keyshift` (Number) hardware lb-2nd-hier-keyshift.
- `load_sharing_udf_length` (Number) source-destination udf length.
- `load_sharing_udf_offset` (Number) source-destination udf.
- `load_sharing_universal_id` (Number) Universal-ID(Random seed).
- `logging_level` (String) Logging level.
- `redirect_syslog` (String) ipv4 redirect syslog.
- `redirect_syslog_interval` (Number) redirect syslog interval.
- `source_route` (String) Source-Route.
- `vrfs` (Attributes Map) List of IPv4 VRF configurations.
  - Map key: `name` - The name of the object. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--vrfs))

<a id="nestedatt--vrfs"></a>
### Nested Schema for `vrfs`

Read-Only:

- `auto_discard` (String) Auto-Discard.
- `icmp_errors_source_interface` (String) ICMP errors source-interface.
- `interfaces` (Attributes Map) List of IPv4 interfaces.
  - Map key: `interface_id` - Must match first field in the output of `show intf brief`. Example: `eth1/1`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--vrfs--interfaces))
- `static_route_bfd_sessions` (Attributes Map) List of IPv4 static route BFD sessions.
  - Map key format: `<interface_id>;<next_hop>`
  - Key component `interface_id`: Interface. Must match first field in the output of `show intf brief`. Example: `eth1/1` or `vlan100`.
  - Key component `next_hop`: Nexthop Address. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--vrfs--static_route_bfd_sessions))
- `static_routes` (Attributes Map) List of IPv4 static routes.
  - Map key: `prefix` - Prefix. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--vrfs--static_routes))

<a id="nestedatt--vrfs--interfaces"></a>
### Nested Schema for `vrfs.interfaces`

Read-Only:

- `addresses` (Attributes Map) List of IPv4 interface addresses.
  - Map key: `address` - Address. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--vrfs--interfaces--addresses))
- `directed_broadcast` (String) IP directed broadcast.
- `directed_broadcast_acl` (String) IP directed broadcast ACL.
- `drop_glean` (String) ip drop-glean enabled/disabled.
- `forward` (String) IP forward.
- `unnumbered` (String) IP unnumbered. Reference to interface must match first field in the output of `show intf brief`. Example: `eth1/1`.
- `urpf` (String) URPF Info.

<a id="nestedatt--vrfs--interfaces--addresses"></a>
### Nested Schema for `vrfs.interfaces.addresses`

Read-Only:

- `control` (String) The control state.
- `preference` (Number) Preference.
- `tag` (Number) Route Tag.
- `type` (String) Type.
- `use_bia` (String) Use Interface MAC Address.
- `vpc_peer` (String) VPC Peer.



<a id="nestedatt--vrfs--static_route_bfd_sessions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `vrfs.static_route_bfd_sessions`


<a id="nestedatt--vrfs--static_routes"></a>
### Nested Schema for `vrfs.static_routes`

Read-Only:

- `control` (String) Controls.
- `description` (String) Description of the specified attribute.
- `next_hops` (Attributes Map) List of next hops.
  - Map key format: `<interface_id>;<address>;<vrf_name>`
  - Key component `interface_id`: Nexthop Interface. Must match first field in the output of `show intf brief` or `unspecified`. Example: `eth1/1` or `vlan100`.
  - Key component `address`: Nexthop Address.
  - Key component `vrf_name`: Nexthop VRF. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--vrfs--static_routes--next_hops))
- `preference` (Number) Preference.
- `tag` (Number) Tag.

<a id="nestedatt--vrfs--static_routes--next_hops"></a>
### Nested Schema for `vrfs.static_routes.next_hops`

Read-Only:

- `description` (String) Description of the specified attribute.
- `name` (String) Next hop name.
- `object` (Number) Object to be tracked.
- `preference` (Number) Route preference.
- `rewrite_encapsulation` (String) Rewrite Encapsulation.
- `tag` (Number) Tag value.
